accountId.title: Account Id
accountId.description: The Account Id that owns the storefront. Required for security validation.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether the menu should be active immediately. Defaults to true.

itemsJson.title: Items JSON
itemsJson.description: JSON array of menu items. Each object: { "name": "Item Name", "description": "...", "price": 12.99, "calories": 450, "available": true, "imageUrl": "...", "category": "Appetizers" }. Only name is required per item. If category is provided, the action will match or create a Menu_Category__c record automatically.

menuDisplayName.title: Menu Display Name
menuDisplayName.description: Customer-facing display name (Menu__c.Menu_Display_Name__c). Defaults to menuName if not provided.

menuName.title: Menu Name
menuName.description: The name for the new menu (Menu__c.Name). Required.

storefrontId.title: Storefront Id
storefrontId.description: The Storefront__c record Id to create the menu for.
